rationale: Refine only basket-transport rejection handling: retain the parent's first target, but after an explicit zero-action no_collision_free_path rejection, try up to three alternatives within the same assigned basket. Alternatives use the calibrated 1.01 m release height; offset candidates use normalized basket orientation and footprint-based insets. This may avoid ending the entire sorting run because one release pose is unreachable. The six-item attempt cap and executed-motion structure remain unchanged: rejected alternatives execute zero actions, and search stops at the first accepted transport. Exceptions and other primitive errors terminate without retries. Accepted calls are not treated as evidence of attachment or task success.
